offers_products.reason: Card readers, kiosks, smart coolers, and vending management software (Seed) are core offerings.

offers_services.reason: Payment processing and cloud-based device and vending management services are main offerings alongside hardware.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are vending operators, markets, and venues; shoppers only use the machines.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to vending operators, hotels, stadiums, gaming venues, and event businesses.

recurring_revenue.reason: Transaction processing fees and software subscriptions with monthly payments drive most revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Revenue is mainly transaction-based and subscription fees on operating machines; small purchases are hard to cut.

big_ticket.reason: Small micropayment fees and monthly subscriptions; card readers are low-cost.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for software, payment technology, and devices, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly small and mid-sized vending operators, though some larger operators exist.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and payments platform with outsourced device manufacturing; no heavy plants or fleets needed.
